title: Xometry to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 4, 2026
summary: NORTH BETHESDA, Md., July 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Xometry, Inc. (NASDAQ: XMTR), the global AI-native marketplace connecting buyers and suppliers of custom manufacturing, today announced it will report its second quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on August 4, 2026.
body_markdown:
NORTH BETHESDA, Md., July 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Xometry, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=VACxMw_yMmy_a1yvL8xQOBsSHEpaTxqMEU_4oSAoyRi_WiSivlRIrj9HnpKWxhyiAkHw7E9B6Xd4jIoSLk107Q==) (NASDAQ: XMTR), the global AI-native marketplace connecting buyers and suppliers of custom manufacturing, today announced it will report its second quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on August 4, 2026.


Xometry will host its conference call and webcast to discuss the results at 8:30 a.m. ET (5:30 a.m. PT) on the same day. In addition to its press release announcing its second quarter 2026 financial results, Xometry will also release an earnings presentation, which will be available on its[Investor Relations website](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=pyO8rpZ4GSQhVWzJegO811RjBj5u4WoXQlHLkXYGCjlAU3KuEPvdOrn_TBrxYKYgFt-ZsklLOTg0EcZyKX1-kjp3DzECajYL8vgtDI-n-NrYf4p8Tv46jdfg3HyJc9sF) .


**Xometry, Inc.** **Q2** **20** **26** **Earnings** **Presentation and Conference Call**


- Tuesday, August 4, 2026
- 8:30 a.m. ET / 5:30 a.m. PT
- Investors and participants can[register in advance here](https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BI222343e354474d48b1b3d15bd8dbf482) .
- You may also visit the Xometry Investor Relations Homepage at[investors.xometry.com](https://investors.xometry.com/) to listen to a live webcast of the call.


The earnings presentation webcast will be archived within the[Investor Relations section](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=pyO8rpZ4GSQhVWzJegO817R0BZ4UdLgZfvMKE2wG4hyDTd79_nc3F868hWP0p-zUe8bUANhs3hiTvMJmTFau0SggUo02rtzdsWnrveCkqjQeMgccaAt1xbgEFVFas-bP) of Xometry’s website.
